title: ControlSurface.pad_layout
contract: The symbol is get/observe only. Printed Push2/3 layouts distinguish melodic64, melodic64+variations, sequencer, sequencer+32notes; drum variations,64pads,loop selector,16velocities,16pitches; and session. Instrument and Note/Session/Layout context conditions apply. This is not a settable layout selector or a Push1 protocol.

title: ControlSurface.get_control
contract: Parameter name is printed without a declared type; the function returns the named control. Control object class, missing-name return and usable name grammar are not supplied.

title: ControlSurface.get_control_names
contract: Returns a list of all control names for that surface. Ordering, name encoding, list length and implicit function arguments are unspecified.

title: ControlSurface.grab_control
contract: Parameter control is printed without a type. Taking ownership releases standard functionality of that control for exclusive Max for Live use; the statement is scoped to that owned control, not a global hardware mute.

title: ControlSurface.grab_midi
contract: Forwarding concerns messages the surface script receives and explicitly requests from Live. Pure realtime track messages can bypass that script; Push Note pads are the source example, contrasted with Session. This does not promise all raw MIDI from the hardware.

title: ControlSurface.register_midi_control
contract: MaxForLive surface only: name[symbol],status[int],number[int]. Printed status codes are144 note-on,176 CC,224 pitchbend. Returns the control LOM ID; associated forwarding is described after registration plus grab. A send_value call on the returned control is mentioned without defining that separate object member.

title: ControlSurface.release_control
contract: Parameter control is printed without a type. Release re-establishes the standard functionality for that control; return value and repeated/unowned-release semantics are unspecified.

title: ControlSurface.release_midi
contract: Stops forwarding messages received from that surface to Max for Live. Interaction with other receivers or automatic cleanup is unspecified.

title: ControlSurface.send_midi
contract: Parameter midi_message is a list of int, sent to the surface. Range, message framing, running status, supported message classes, acknowledgement and return type are unspecified.

title: ControlSurface.send_receive_sysex
contract: Printed parameters sysex_message[list of int],timeout[symbol,int] coexist with prose specifying timeout followed by a float and a default0.2 with no unit in this entry. It awaits a response: ungrabbed timed-out response is not forwarded; grabbed MIDI is always forwarded while timeout is still reported. Exact report grammar, units, response correlation and boundary timing remain U.

title: DeviceIO.available_routing_channels
contract: Dictionary get/observe. Printed key available_routing_channels holds a list of dictionaries described by routing_channel. This is an availability listing, not audio-path activation proof.

title: DeviceIO.available_routing_types
contract: Dictionary get/observe. Printed key available_routing_types holds a list of dictionaries described by routing_type; ordering and empty-list meaning are unspecified.

title: DeviceIO.default_external_routing_channel_is_none
contract: Bool get/set, described since Live11:1 means the default channel for External routing types is none. Other values, initialization, persistence and switching/selection side effects are not specified.

title: DeviceIO.routing_channel
contract: Dictionary get/set/observe with display_name[symbol] and identifier[symbol]; can be set to values found in available_routing_channels. Label alone is not the stable identity or a complete serialization law.

title: DeviceIO.routing_type
contract: Dictionary get/set/observe with display_name[symbol] and identifier[symbol]; can be set to values found in available_routing_types. Compatibility with current channel and invalid/stale selection behavior remain U.

title: Groove.base
contract: Printed under Children despite primitive int; get/set only. Index-based values are0=1/4,1=1/8,2=1/8T,3=1/16,4=1/16T,5=1/32. Do not silently reclassify as an object child or infer an observable capability.

title: Groove.name
contract: Printed under Children as symbol get/set/observe; represents the groove name. Encoding, duplicate-name identity and persistence are unspecified.

title: Groove.quantization_amount
contract: Printed under Children as float get/set/observe; represents the quantization amount. No unit, accepted range, percent conversion or timing algorithm is provided.

title: Groove.random_amount
contract: Printed under Children as float get/set/observe; represents random amount. Range, units, random distribution, seed and note correlation are unspecified.

title: Groove.timing_amount
contract: Printed under Children as float get/set/observe; represents timing amount. Units, scale, extrapolation, mapping and timing transformation remain unknown.

title: Groove.velocity_amount
contract: Printed under Children as float get/set/observe; represents velocity amount. Units, signed range, clipping and interaction with notes/groove dynamics remain unknown.

title: GroovePool.grooves
contract: Child list of Groove, get/observe only; source says top-to-bottom pool order, accessible by index. Empty/stale indices, reordering, loading/removal and notification ordering are unspecified.

title: TuningSystem.name
contract: Symbol get/set/observe; names the currently active tuning system. Renaming is not evidence of loading a different system or changing pitch.

title: TuningSystem.pseudo_octave_in_cents
contract: Float get only; pseudo-octave in cents for the current system. No setter, accepted numerical range or relationship to an octave number is specified.

title: TuningSystem.lowest_note
contract: Dictionary get/set/observe describing note index within pseudo-octave and octave of the lowest note. Key names, key types, integer ranges and inclusive/exclusive boundary behavior are not supplied.

title: TuningSystem.highest_note
contract: Dictionary get/set/observe describing note index within pseudo-octave and octave of the highest note. Missing schema and range/interaction rules remain U.

title: TuningSystem.reference_pitch
contract: Dictionary get/set/observe for current reference pitch. Keys, units, tuning reference coordinate and validation rules are unspecified.

title: TuningSystem.note_tunings
contract: Dictionary get/set/observe; relative note tunings in cents, described as a single-element dictionary holding an array. The key, array size/order, reference meaning and accepted values are not supplied.

title: this_device root context
contract: The root identifies the Device containing the live.path object receiving goto this_device. The entry prints an ordinary track/device canonical path example; nested/return/Main placements and lifetime follow their own evidence, not an all-devices-on-tracks law. The entry declares zero direct members; Device inheritance is routed to its separate owner.

title: Controller ownership, timeout and lifecycle
contract: Surface ordering differs between Application list and root path; script-requested versus realtime forwarding, grab/release ownership, wrong-owner cleanup, disconnect, timeout parameter int/float discrepancy and unspecified units need matched evidence.

title: Routing dictionary and bus lifecycle
contract: Bus identity/cardinality, dictionary serialization, stale/invalid routing IDs, type/channel interaction, persistence and actual signal/latency outcomes remain unknown.

title: Groove amounts and pool lifecycle
contract: Printed Children primitives do not establish navigable object children; amount units/ranges/algorithms, pool mutation/identity, probability/timing and commit/persistence remain unknown.

title: Tuning dictionaries and active-system lifecycle
contract: Missing dictionary keys/units/ranges and empty/no-system behavior prevent complete typed payload contracts; scale/clip/device/pitch conversion and persistence remain unknown.
